propositions: Proposed deterministic clarity criteria that mandate literal section headings (Approach, Scope) reject valid closed tickets where semantic equivalents exist in alternative sections (Why, What).

Lexicon-only detection of placeholder language (check if, TBD) produces false positives on mechanically decidable conditionals and bounded actions that lack explicit proof markers but pass completion verification.

Hard requirements for per-AC explicit proof-coverage markers (verified by) discard valid tickets with precise behavioral oracles and completed work that passed both plan-review and completion-verifier without such sentinels.

Edit-set and file_impact requirements are unsound for read-only analysis, operational, and external-attestation work where explicit no-edit contracts make repository diffs nonexistent or durable outputs reside in ticket comments.

Deterministic conjunction-count and vague-hedge heuristics cannot distinguish coherent cross-surface invariants bundled into single ACs from incoherent vagueness, producing false advisory signals on valid matrices.
